title: Google playground vs a game platform concept I've been playing around with
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
Have any of you tried google playground? I was excited at first but very disappointed they would release such a slop producing tool given their immense scale and resources!

After seeing what google did, I spent the last couple weeks building out what I think is a much higher quality system for cloud game development.

[GameCrew AI](http://gamecrew.ai)

If you want to alpha test, you are welcome to request a seat. There are limited seats since there is some cost to generations and I really want to ensure I get folks who can provide feedback in terms of where to take this concept.

Right now gamecrew can produce games in a variety of frameworks including unity, godot, threejs, and a very early agent friendly engine I've been attempting to build called pulse.

The system uses a variety of sub agents, blender, tripo/meshy for asset gen, elevenlabs for audio, etc.

Google playground version: [https://playground.google/game/1252184206602597671?ref=your\_games](https://playground.google/game/1252184206602597671?ref=your_games)

Gamecrew AI version: [https://play.gamecrew.ai/t/2XYCzcCX8iRi-NIXq0YWZmRg12y4QdDV/](https://play.gamecrew.ai/t/2XYCzcCX8iRi-NIXq0YWZmRg12y4QdDV/)
